title: Code Factory: Proof-by-Sabotage Software Factory
description:
Code Factory is a proof-first, open-source software factory for turning specifications, behavior checks, design contracts, policy verification, Mermaid diagrams, and release receipts into auditable delivery through Unified Graph Ops. Version 0.35 adds Factory Continuity: a local metadata ledger that binds prior decisions to purpose, repository scope, evidence hashes, expiry, and independent promotion. Unified Graph Ops shows only a redacted, read-only Decision Replay projection so a team can reconsider verified work without silently reusing stale context. Release media includes the current FactoryLine identity asset and real product captures.

Evidence boundary: Factory Continuity is not a hosted memory service and stores no private content, embeddings, vectors, prompts, or transcripts. It does not authenticate users, provide RLS/KMS, execute commands, alter source or policy, approve, merge, publish, deploy, sign, message, access credentials, or grant connectors. Time, token, and cost savings require exact paired observations; productivity remains unavailable without separate measured evidence. A passing receipt proves the declared checks and supplied environment, not arbitrary production security.
